description: Manage the basic settings of this module here

content.name: name
content.description: Name of the Ticket type. This will be shown to users

content.name: ticket-create-category
content.description: Category in which tickets should get created.

content.name: ticket-create-channel
content.description: Channel in which a message with a "Create Ticket" button should get send

content.name: ticketRoles
content.description: Users who get pinged in the tickets and who can see tickets

content.name: logChannel
content.description: Channel in which ticket logs should get send

content.name: ticket-create-message
content.default: Click the big button below to contact our staff and create a ticket
content.description: Message that gets send/edited in the ticket-create-channel

content.name: sendUserDMAfterTicketClose
content.humanName: Send user DM after ticket is closed
content.description: If enabled users get a DM from the bot after someone closes the ticket

content.name: userDM
content.default: Thanks for contacting our support for the ticket-category "%type%", here is your transcript: %transcriptURL%
content.description: This message gets send to the user if sendUserDMAfterTicketClose is enabled

content.name: creation-message
content.description: This message will get sent in new tickets. The close buttons will be added.

fields.name: ℹ️ Information
fields.value: Your issue got solved? Click the button below. You can always find this message pinned.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identification number of the ticket

params.name: userMention
params.description: Mention of the user who created this ticket

params.name: rolePings
params.description: Mention of the roles you have selected in the "Ticket roles" field

params.name: userTag
params.description: Tag of the user who created this ticket
